#### What's New at Exterro

Learn about all the latest news from Exterro, featuring news and press coverage, product updates,

[

Exterro ARMOUR for FTK

Exterro ARMOUR for FTK brings the power of agentic AI to forensic investigations. Investigators can
begin with a plain-language objectives and reach evidence-supported findings faster across live
endpoints as agentic AI coordinates actions across endpoints.

][159][
ediscovery software
Subpoena Manager

Take the drudgery out of subpoena response with Exterro Subpoena Manager. Our first product release
in the ARMOUR framework moves you from fragmented email intake and spreadsheet tracking to a
governed autonomous AI-driven workflow that's 95% faster than traditional, manual workflows.

][160][
exterro case study
Racing the Clock: Exterro FTK Powers the FBI's Assassination Investigation

When an attempted presidential assassination demanded answers in hours, not days, the FBI Washington
Field Office turned to Exterro FTK Suite. Read the case study to learn how the capabilities of
Exterro FTK deliver the power, speed, and insight to crack major investigations in hours, not days
or weeks.

][161]
[Man in a gray sweater working on a computer with multiple monitors displaying code and data in an
office.]

### What is Data Risk Management?  And why does it matter?

[
Learn More About Data Risk
[Arrow right to navigation]][162]

Data risk is what happens when information is lost, exposed, or misused and the legal, financial and
reputational fallout that follows. In a world where data is everywhere, risk is everywhere too.

Data risk management is the practice of identifying, assessing, and controlling the legal,
regulatory, and reputational risks that arise from how an organization collects, stores, and uses
data. It spans eDiscovery, digital forensics, data privacy, and information governance — disciplines
that are increasingly interconnected as data volumes grow and regulations multiply.

#### As data risk grows, AI should be helping solve it. But most AI still stops before the real work
#### starts.

Today, most AI is being used to answer questions and summarize data. Exterro sees the bigger
opportunity in reducing the manual coordination, disconnected handoffs, and process drag that slow
legal and compliance workflows down every day.

#### That is exactly why Exterro created ARMOUR.

Exterro ARMOUR is our agentic AI orchestration framework — purpose-built to autonomously coordinate
legal, privacy, and compliance workflows across the enterprise.

[
Explore The Vision
][163][
See It In Action
][164]
Less Busywork
Reduce the manual steps, follow-up, and coordination that slow teams down.
Lower Operating Costs
Cut the labor-heavy work, process drag, and outside support that make response expensive.
More Capacity
Handle more legal and risk work without the same increase in headcount or overhead.
More Time for Work that Matters
Free teams from repetitive administrative work so they can focus on judgment, strategy, and things
that actually require their expertise.
Faster Outcomes, Better Control
Move important work forward with less delay while keeping oversight where it matters.

#### The stakes are too high for yesterday’s solutions.

### Built for the realities of the data risk era.

Exterro puts specialized agents and agentic orchestration to work against data risk, turning
complexity into clarity and giving teams the visibility, speed, and confidence they’ve never had
from legacy tools.

[

Reduce risk through defensible workflows.
Ensure every action is tracked, repeatable, and audit-ready, so your process stands strong when
scrutiny is highest.
Speed up legal outcomes.
Accelerate every step from identification to review with connected, automated workflows built to
keep cases moving.

#### Industry-leading digital forensics & breach response tools

[

Collect and analyze forensic evidence at scale.
Gather, process, and interpret evidence from any endpoint with consistent, repeatable precision

Power breach response with AI-driven review.
Accelerate investigations with AI that surfaces what matters fast, so responders can act sooner and
with greater certainty.
Support field triage and chain of custody.
Equip teams to capture, preserve, and transfer evidence correctly every time, maintaining integrity

Data Governance

#### Unified data privacy, security, and governance

every jurisdiction.

### What is Data Risk Management?  And why does it matter?

[
Learn More About Data Risk
[Arrow right to navigation]][162]

Data risk is what happens when information is lost, exposed, or misused and the legal, financial and
reputational fallout that follows. In a world where data is everywhere, risk is everywhere too.

Data risk management is the practice of identifying, assessing, and controlling the legal,
regulatory, and reputational risks that arise from how an organization collects, stores, and uses
data. It spans eDiscovery, digital forensics, data privacy, and information governance — disciplines
that are increasingly interconnected as data volumes grow and regulations multiply.

#### As data risk grows, AI should be helping solve it. But most AI still stops before the real work
#### starts.

Today, most AI is being used to answer questions and summarize data. Exterro sees the bigger
opportunity in reducing the manual coordination, disconnected handoffs, and process drag that slow
legal and compliance workflows down every day.

#### That is exactly why Exterro created ARMOUR.

Exterro ARMOUR is our agentic AI orchestration framework — purpose-built to autonomously coordinate
legal, privacy, and compliance workflows across the enterprise.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

### 30-day money back guarantee

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

Transform your approach to litigation and investigations with the world’s most advanced ediscovery
software.

[Play video] [ Play this video on Vimeo ][46] [product-illustration-deep-dive]

## Analyze Millions of Documents to Find the Truth in Seconds

Explore your entire corpus to pinpoint the truth that can shape your case. Deep Dive navigates your
entire data set to surface specific insights with direct citations, giving you total confidence in
the facts without the manual search. Proven reliability across sets of 10 million documents and
more.

[product-illustration-review-coding-suggestions]

Coding Suggestions

### Automate First-Pass Review

Accelerate your review of new documents and perform rapid quality control, with performance on par
or exceeding eyes-on review. Coding Suggestions delivers AI automation by instantly categorizing
documents and providing clear rationales based on your specific coding sheet.

[product-illustration-storybuilder-writing-assistant-rewrite]

Writing Assistant

### Draft More Persuasive Arguments

Move seamlessly from discovery to first draft with a tireless AI thought partner that synthesizes
your evidence and brainstorms case strategy in real time. Writing Assistant quickly compiles facts
into cohesive narratives, freeing you to focus on the high-level legal work that drives results.

enables legal teams to do more than ever before.

[Product - Communication Visualizer with Right-hand Menu, Palsgraf Theme]

the facts without the manual search. Proven reliability across sets of 10 million documents and
more.

into cohesive narratives, freeing you to focus on the high-level legal work that drives results.

## Discover the advantages of Reveal

### Tell me something I don't know

Use Reveal's wide-reaching tools to explore your data from many angles and in many ways. Use the
power of Reveal to learn something new, and drive your matter forward.

### Find more like this

Sometimes, finding one document isn't enough; you need to locate as many copies and variations as
you can. With Reveal's technology, workflows, and reports, quickly find the "more like this" you
need.

### Good for the full life of a matter

Reveal's got you covered from the first whiff of a matter through its final disposition. Identify
data in place. Manage the hold process. Collect data with connectors, then process and host it.
Review, analyze, and synthesize as needed.

### Secure

Your data must be safe. That's why Reveal is committed to ensuring the security, confidentiality,
and integrity of your data. We abide by the three pillars of our AI pledge: Trust, Knowledge, and
Security.

### Scalable

Sometimes, it's enough to grab data, cull it, produce, and move on. Other times, you need the full
power of a robust AI-driven platform. Whether you handle the work yourself or prefer an ALSP's
services, Reveal can scale to meet your needs.

### Predictable costs

If ever you had to take a big, unexpected bill to a partner or client, you quickly learned you never
want to go through that experience again. That's why we work with you to make our costs as clear and
predictable as possible.

## Intelligent transformation.

We empower our clients to harness the transformative power of AI by enabling smarter
decision-making, automating complex processes, personalizing customer experiences, driving
innovation, and securing competitive advantages.

[Learn more][50]

## The right experts at the right time.

Our team of cross-industry, cross-disciplinary experts are trusted advisors who partner with our
clients – listening, learning, and charting the next steps that Protect, Create, and Recover Value
through challenging times or events.

[Learn more][51]

## Critical expertise in crisis situations.

Disruption is the new normal and change will continue to accelerate at a dramatic pace. Our global
team delivers the strategies and solutions that keep our clients ahead. Where others advise, we
solve. Where others consult, we partner.

[Learn more][52]

## For the opportunity. For the future.

We are a firm of experts and advisors uniquely built to tackle each challenge or need, and we
effectively combine the right expertise into solutions, services, and results. We don’t just talk
about bringing the best together; we do it.

[Learn more][53]

## Global coverage. Targeted impact.

Where industries, disciplines, technologies, and trends intersect and when existential moments and
events overlap – Ankura is there, putting our world-class expertise to work for our clients. We
develop and execute creative, end-to-end solutions and provide the expertise and skills our clients
need at critical moments.

[Learn more][54]

## Collaborative lateral thinking.

We are the experts and advisors who advise the world’s leading governments, businesses, and
institutions to solve their biggest challenges and most complex problems by developing game-changing
ideas that achieve positive outcomes.

[Learn more][55]

## Experts in motion. Advisors in action.

Our multidisciplinary expertise comes together with efficiency and speed, allowing us to respond to
events, and generate solutions in real-time. Integrating seamlessly across the firm, our team of
experts and advisors work together in a collaborative model to address the challenges our clients
face.

[Learn more][56]

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized

## Discover How Simple eDiscovery Can Be

Electronic discovery (aka eDiscovery or e-discovery) is a process used to collect, upload, review,
produce, and analyze electronically stored information (ESI) in response to legal requests. ESI can
include emails, SMS, text, documents, presentations, databases, voicemail, audio and video files,
social media activity, web sites, and a variety of proprietary file types, file formats, and file
metadata. Robust eDiscovery solutions must support this diverse array of data types and facilitate
processing at all of the interdependent stages – which most often run in parallel.

The complexity of handling eDiscovery within a law firm, corporation or government continues to
grow. As data volume and types increase, managing the eDiscovery process for even a mainstream
matter or investigation can be overwhelming, time consuming and costly.

There is a smarter way to take control of eDiscovery.

### How We Help eDiscovery Legal Teams

CloudNine, an industry standard setter and innovator, empowers you to simplify eDiscovery, external
and internal investigations, audits and access requests for law firms, corporations, and government
agencies. Our on-premise and cloud-based eDiscovery solutions allow you to upload, review and
produce documents from one platform in minutes. Our solutions are easy to use and have all the core
features you need. We also offer comprehensive, expert eDiscovery services, from project management
to managed review. Our professional services team is here to help.

These days saving eDiscovery time, cost and effort make more sense than ever before.

It’s time to get on CloudNine.

## Discover How Simple eDiscovery Can Be

Electronic discovery (aka eDiscovery or e-discovery) is a process used to collect, upload, review,
produce, and analyze electronically stored information (ESI) in response to legal requests. ESI can
include emails, SMS, text, documents, presentations, databases, voicemail, audio and video files,
social media activity, web sites, and a variety of proprietary file types, file formats, and file
metadata. Robust eDiscovery solutions must support this diverse array of data types and facilitate
processing at all of the interdependent stages – which most often run in parallel.

The complexity of handling eDiscovery within a law firm, corporation or government continues to
grow. As data volume and types increase, managing the eDiscovery process for even a mainstream
matter or investigation can be overwhelming, time consuming and costly.

There is a smarter way to take control of eDiscovery.

# Full-Service Litigation Support Firm in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York & Delaware

Before filing a lawsuit, developing a case, preparing your defense, or attempting to uncover crucial
evidence, consider enlisting a professional litigation support company to help your law firm and
legal team prepare for and execute at trial. Our seasoned and certified technical experts can aid in
handling the complex technological aspects of your case, allowing you to enjoy a timely and
cost-effective outcome.

Cornerstone Discovery is an award-winning and reliable litigation support firm that seeks to address
your criminal and civil litigation support needs. Our services are available in Pennsylvania, New
Jersey, New York, Delaware, and beyond. In fact, we are now a nationally recognized company offering
our services across the country! Contact us today for support in and out of the courtroom.

Read More

## A Closer Look at Our Litigation Support Services

In an era where a single case can involve thousands of documents, complex digital footprints, and
the need for compelling visual presentations in the courtroom, having a dedicated support team is
integral for success. This is why law firms and legal teams turn to Cornerstone Discovery for
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions.

Our [litigation support services][30] are designed to help legal professionals manage the entire
lifecycle of a case, from initial discovery through to the final verdict. This includes strategic
consulting on data management, forensic collection of evidence, streamlined electronic discovery,
graphic design and printing services, exhibit management, and dynamic trial presentation
development. Through these solutions, our litigation support firm eases the burden of technology so
that you can focus on winning.

### [Digital Forensics Services][31]

Cornerstone Discovery offers digital investigation services to collect and preserve critical
evidence from mobile devices, laptops, servers, and cloud accounts. Our forensic investigators,
certified digital forensic examiners, litigation consultants, legal project managers, and
e-Discovery Specialists leave no stone unturned and extract and preserve the data you need to
support your case.

Our digital forensic solutions include Preservation & Collection (of digital devices, servers,
etc.), Analysis & Reporting, and Expert Witness Testimony & Rebuttal in court. We can assist in a
variety of matters that involve digital devices and data, from extensive corporate investigations
(i.e., stolen trade secrets), internal governmental investigations, and internal investigations for
public entities like school districts, colleges, and universities to criminal investigations (i.e.,
cybercrimes) and more.

### [e-Discovery Services][32]

Once we forensically collect and preserve the data, our e-Discovery specialists can process vast
amounts of data by setting a protocol to define search parameters, as well as assist with refining
and negotiating an ESI protocol, executing searches, automating privilege logs, managing review
teams, and producing relevant data. We work with you on your individual case to assess your needs
and offer the most cost-effective and complete solutions to ensure projects get done on time and
within budget. We also offer an online collaborative document review platform, [Junto][33], to
enhance the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of your electronic discovery efforts.

### [Trial Support][34]

In today’s trials, judges and juries expect visually appealing and technology-driven presentations.
With our certified trial technicians and litigation technology support staff in your corner before,
during, and after trial, you will be equipped with the latest creative solutions to best represent
your case.

## How Our Capabilities Drive Your Law Firm’s Legal Strategy

### An Integrated, Full-Service Model

Unlike other criminal and civil litigation support firms that specialize in only one area, we
provide a seamless, integrated experience covering digital forensics, e-Discovery, and trial
support. This eliminates the friction and potential for error that can occur when working with
multiple vendors. Our forensics team can collect the data, our e-Discovery team can manage its
review, and our trial team can prepare exhibits for court — all under one roof.

### Unmatched Expertise

Our team consists of certified experts who don’t just know technology; they understand its legal
application and how to ensure our processes and findings withstand the highest levels of scrutiny.

### A Technology-Forward Approach

We are committed to investing in and mastering the most advanced technology in the industry. From
powerful forensic tools to AI-driven review platforms, we leverage cutting-edge solutions to deliver
superior results more efficiently.

### A True Partnership

We view our clients as partners. We take the time to understand the unique facts and strategic goals
of each case, tailoring our approach to meet your specific needs and budget while providing
strategic advice every step of the way.

# Full-Service Litigation Support Firm in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York & Delaware

Before filing a lawsuit, developing a case, preparing your defense, or attempting to uncover crucial
evidence, consider enlisting a professional litigation support company to help your law firm and
legal team prepare for and execute at trial. Our seasoned and certified technical experts can aid in
handling the complex technological aspects of your case, allowing you to enjoy a timely and
cost-effective outcome.

Cornerstone Discovery is an award-winning and reliable litigation support firm that seeks to address
your criminal and civil litigation support needs. Our services are available in Pennsylvania, New
Jersey, New York, Delaware, and beyond. In fact, we are now a nationally recognized company offering
our services across the country! Contact us today for support in and out of the courtroom.

Read More

## A Closer Look at Our Litigation Support Services

In an era where a single case can involve thousands of documents, complex digital footprints, and
the need for compelling visual presentations in the courtroom, having a dedicated support team is
integral for success. This is why law firms and legal teams turn to Cornerstone Discovery for
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions.

Our [litigation support services][30] are designed to help legal professionals manage the entire
lifecycle of a case, from initial discovery through to the final verdict. This includes strategic
consulting on data management, forensic collection of evidence, streamlined electronic discovery,
graphic design and printing services, exhibit management, and dynamic trial presentation
development. Through these solutions, our litigation support firm eases the burden of technology so
that you can focus on winning.

### [Digital Forensics Services][31]

Cornerstone Discovery offers digital investigation services to collect and preserve critical
evidence from mobile devices, laptops, servers, and cloud accounts. Our forensic investigators,
certified digital forensic examiners, litigation consultants, legal project managers, and
e-Discovery Specialists leave no stone unturned and extract and preserve the data you need to
support your case.

Our digital forensic solutions include Preservation & Collection (of digital devices, servers,
etc.), Analysis & Reporting, and Expert Witness Testimony & Rebuttal in court. We can assist in a
variety of matters that involve digital devices and data, from extensive corporate investigations
(i.e., stolen trade secrets), internal governmental investigations, and internal investigations for
public entities like school districts, colleges, and universities to criminal investigations (i.e.,
cybercrimes) and more.

### [e-Discovery Services][32]

Once we forensically collect and preserve the data, our e-Discovery specialists can process vast
amounts of data by setting a protocol to define search parameters, as well as assist with refining
and negotiating an ESI protocol, executing searches, automating privilege logs, managing review
teams, and producing relevant data. We work with you on your individual case to assess your needs
and offer the most cost-effective and complete solutions to ensure projects get done on time and
within budget. We also offer an online collaborative document review platform, [Junto][33], to
enhance the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of your electronic discovery efforts.

### [Trial Support][34]

In today’s trials, judges and juries expect visually appealing and technology-driven presentations.
With our certified trial technicians and litigation technology support staff in your corner before,
during, and after trial, you will be equipped with the latest creative solutions to best represent
your case.

## How Our Capabilities Drive Your Law Firm’s Legal Strategy

### An Integrated, Full-Service Model

Unlike other criminal and civil litigation support firms that specialize in only one area, we
provide a seamless, integrated experience covering digital forensics, e-Discovery, and trial
support. This eliminates the friction and potential for error that can occur when working with
multiple vendors. Our forensics team can collect the data, our e-Discovery team can manage its
review, and our trial team can prepare exhibits for court — all under one roof.

### Unmatched Expertise

Our team consists of certified experts who don’t just know technology; they understand its legal
application and how to ensure our processes and findings withstand the highest levels of scrutiny.

### A Technology-Forward Approach

We are committed to investing in and mastering the most advanced technology in the industry. From
powerful forensic tools to AI-driven review platforms, we leverage cutting-edge solutions to deliver
superior results more efficiently.

### A True Partnership

We view our clients as partners. We take the time to understand the unique facts and strategic goals
of each case, tailoring our approach to meet your specific needs and budget while providing
strategic advice every step of the way.

## Offering eDiscovery Services, Consulting, Software and Project Support for more efficient
## collection, review and production of ESI.

[Reveal’s interactive data visualization]
Be productive, efficient and organized

At Datamine, our systems and solutions give you access to:
* Forensically sound data collection from sources such as email accounts, cell phones, hard drives
  and social media platforms. 
* Secure hosted review of these data sources in one organized software location.  
* Easy privilege tagging, full searchability and file sorting so you can find relevant documents
  quickly and accurately for production. 
* Collaborate with your team members, co-counsel and experts. 
* Our service and support team, who are available to provide unlimited training and are responsive
  to any questions that you have. 

Let Datamine Discovery Handle the Heavy Data Work...
Trying to collect, review and produce electronically stored information can be overwhelming If you
do not have a plan. Let us help with the following:
[ REQUEST CONSULTATION TODAY ][37]

### Hosted Data
### Review

Making sense out of voluminous data. Host, share, search, review, tag, issue code, organize incoming
- outgoing productions and prepare for deposition and trial.
Our hosted review tools efficiently and defensibly reduce even the largest datasets to the most
relevant information.
[ LEARN MORE ][38]

### ECA & Data Collection

Perform Forensic collection from any data source. Collect - Cull - Preserve
We offer flexible Early Case Assessment (ECA) and Data Collection, with support from our Boston
consultants, whether before or after collection.
[ LEARN MORE ][39]

### Legal Hold
### Services

Take advantage of an integrated, automated, and defensible software platform.
Our legal hold solution includes managing notifications. Datamine Discovery simplifies compliance by
easily informing custodians to preserve data.
[ LEARN MORE ][40]

### Data Processing
### Services

Prepare your collected data for quicker review and ensure you find the documents you are searching
for.
Data Processing is key to eDiscovery. It converts data for faster review and enables effective
searching to find relevant documents.
[ LEARN MORE ][41]

### Early Case
### Assessment

Let our eDiscovery team help you with cost reduction and strategy development.
Early Case Assessment (ECA) in eDiscovery can be done before or after data collection, depending on
your case needs. You can use ECA software to gather information pre-collection or take a traditional
post-collection approach.
[ LEARN MORE ][42]

### Data
### Production

Helping you produce evidence to the other side according to specification and in any format that you
need.
Ready to produce evidence? Datamine Discovery ensures timely delivery of relevant documents in the
correct format, meeting your discovery agreement specifications.
[ LEARN MORE ][43]

### Paper Discovery
### & Trial Solutions

Meeting your Print, Electronic Evidence, and other Needs.
Discovery is the pre-trial exchange of evidence (electronic or paper). Despite the growth of
electronic data, paper documents still exist and are also subject to discovery.
[ LEARN MORE ][44]

### eDiscovery Artificial Intelligence

Get important data faster. Let AI help you find overlooked and highly relevant information.
Datamine Discovery partners with Reveal, a leader in AI and machine learning, enhanced by their
acquisitions of Brainspace and NexLP AI. This powerful combination provides a comprehensive solution
for analyzing unstructured data in your legal cases.
[ LEARN MORE ][45]

### eDiscovery Project Management & Consulting Services

Experienced Consultants Ready to help, make sense of your data and help you make a plan with your
ESI.
Litigation and investigations involve both paper and electronic discovery. Datamine Discovery
consultants help organize data and find evidence using best practices, navigating the complexities
of both paper and the growing volume of electronic information.
[ LEARN MORE ][46]

### Managed Document Review Services

Helping You with the Complexities of Managed Document Review in eDiscovery.
Managed Document Review (MDR) is a cornerstone of eDiscovery due to the rapid growth of electronic
data and complex legal cases, offering an efficient way to review large document volumes.
[ LEARN MORE ][47]
[ REQUEST CONSULTATION TODAY ][48]

**Our eDiscovery project managers are experts at utilizing A.I. technology that processes enormous
volumes of data and identifies key evidence crucial to a legal case. This may include: **
* Privilege Document Detection – Leveraging A.I. technology to identify privileged documents prior
  to review.
* Data Clean-up – Using A.I. technology to identify and remove unwanted noise in your data set,
  making your review more efficient.
* Toxic Work Environment – Utilizing A.I. technology to identify toxic behavior within unstructured
  data.
* Sexual Harrassment Detection – Using A.I. technology to detect unwanted behavior within your data
  set.

## BOSTON'S TRUSTED EXPERTS IN:

Datamine Discovery is a trusted partner in Reveal, Relativity and Everlaw eDiscovery platforms. Our
consultants will find the right solution to your challenging case.

# Welcome to Discovery Semiconductors: SWIR InGaAs Photodiodes and Photoreceivers for Space

Discovery Semiconductors, Inc. is an industry leader in manufacturing ultrafast, high optical power
handling InGaAs photodetectors, RF over fiber optical receivers, balanced optical receivers,
extended wavelength photodetectors, and several custom products for applications ranging from analog
RF links to ultrafast digital communications. Discovery began operations in 1993 and has grown into
a global enterprise by leading the market with high-technology products for 10, 25, 40, and 100 Gb
applications. Discovery's instrumentation and systems include the Lab Buddy and Optical Coherent
Receiver System. Since 1998, Discovery Semiconductors maintains a world class clean room facility
for manufacturing high reliability products for telecom, datacom, avionics and aerospace
applications. Discovery Semiconductors’ offers 20+ different Photodiodes and Photoreceivers for your
Shortwave Infrared (SWIR) space missions to LEO, GEO, Moon, Mars, and beyond, for applications such
as Sensing, Optical Communications, RF Photonics, LIDAR, and Laser Interferometry. RF Bandwidths
available from few MHz to several GHz. Honoree for 2020 and 2021 Military & Aerospace Electronics
Innovators Award.

**Featured Video**

## Space Qualified InGaAs Quad PD + TIA Photoreceivers


## Description

The Space Qualified InGaAs Quad PD + TIA Photoreceivers from Discovery Semiconductors Inc. offers a
large active area diameter; small photodiode capacitance; small crosstalk between adjacent
quadrants; resilient to radiation for space qualification; and comprehensively tested for radiation
background for the space environment.

susceptible to data loss due to hardware failures, physical damage, malware, and more. Whether the
computer is a Mac, Windows, or part of a RAID, all HDD recoveries are performed in the DriveSavers
state-of-the-art Cleanroom.

# Instantly Search Terabytes

Includes dtSearch's own [document filters][83]

[Supports a wide variety of data types][84]
* PDF: [PDF][85] through PDF 2.0; PDF Portfolio
* Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, OneNote files, including Office 365
* Other "office": OpenOffice; certain international office formats; XBASE; CSV; SPL; multi-format
  image/sound/video metadata support; etc.
* Compression formats: RAR, ZIP, GZIP and TAR
* Emails: Exchange, Outlook, Thunderbird, etc. with multilevel nested attachments
* Web data: HTML, XML/XSL, PDF, ASP.NET, CMS, PHP, WordPress, [SharePoint][86], etc. See also:
  [cloud storage][87]
* Through APIs: [NoSQL / SQL][88] data including BLOB data; other non-file data like network data
  streams; [Azure][89] and [AWS][90] data stores

[Over 25 full-text and metadata search features][91]
* [Efficient multithreaded searching][92] with no limit on the number of concurrent search threads
* [Federated searching][93] with integrated relevancy-ranking across multiple data types
* [Easy][94] [ multicolor hit-highlighting ][95]
* [Forensics-oriented][96] search options (hash support, credit cards, etc.)
* Extensive [international language][97] support
* [Faceted search][98] or “drill down” category searching (through APIs)
* [Data classification][99] with granular search results filtering (through APIs)
* [Faceted search vs. data classification][100] overview

[Developers: add instant search and data support][101]
* Cross-platform APIs cover C++, Java and .NET through current versions; see [cross-platform sample
  code][102] for [faceted search live demo][103] — select "SEC Filings" for faceted search
* SDKs for Windows, Linux, macOS
* The dtSearch Engine also works on cloud platforms like [Azure][104] and [AWS][105].
* [Document filters][106] "only" licenses available

* PDF: [PDF][85] through PDF 2.0; PDF Portfolio
* Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, OneNote files, including Office 365
* Other "office": OpenOffice; certain international office formats; XBASE; CSV; SPL; multi-format
  image/sound/video metadata support; etc.
* Compression formats: RAR, ZIP, GZIP and TAR
* Emails: Exchange, Outlook, Thunderbird, etc. with multilevel nested attachments
* Web data: HTML, XML/XSL, PDF, ASP.NET, CMS, PHP, WordPress, [SharePoint][86], etc. See also:
  [cloud storage][87]
* Through APIs: [NoSQL / SQL][88] data including BLOB data; other non-file data like network data
  streams; [Azure][89] and [AWS][90] data stores

[Over 25 full-text and metadata search features][91]
* [Efficient multithreaded searching][92] with no limit on the number of concurrent search threads
* [Federated searching][93] with integrated relevancy-ranking across multiple data types
* [Easy][94] [ multicolor hit-highlighting ][95]
* [Forensics-oriented][96] search options (hash support, credit cards, etc.)
* Extensive [international language][97] support
* [Faceted search][98] or “drill down” category searching (through APIs)
* [Data classification][99] with granular search results filtering (through APIs)
* [Faceted search vs. data classification][100] overview

[Developers: add instant search and data support][101]
* Cross-platform APIs cover C++, Java and .NET through current versions; see [cross-platform sample
  code][102] for [faceted search live demo][103] — select "SEC Filings" for faceted search
* SDKs for Windows, Linux, macOS
* The dtSearch Engine also works on cloud platforms like [Azure][104] and [AWS][105].
* [Document filters][106] "only" licenses available

Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander (AANHPI) Heritage Month is celebrated each May
to honor the histories, cultures, and contributions of Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific
Islander communities while recognizing their lasting impact on society.

ALS Awareness Month shines a spotlight each May on Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, increasing public
understanding of the disease, supporting advocacy and research efforts, and recognizing those living
with ALS along with their caregivers.

### Building Safety Month

Building Safety Month takes place each May to emphasize the importance of safe construction
practices, updated building codes, and disaster preparedness while helping communities understand
how safer buildings protect lives and property.

Earth and Atmospheric Sciences

### American Wetlands Month

American Wetlands Month focuses on the ecological importance of wetlands, promote conservation and
restoration efforts, and encourage greater awareness of the role these ecosystems play in protecting
wildlife, water quality, and communities.

recognize advances in treatment and care, and support efforts to improve the lives of those living
with this progressive genetic disease.

History

### Labor History Month

Labor History Month is observed each May to recognize the labor movements that helped secure
workplace protections such as the eight-hour workday, safer working conditions, fair wages, and
other rights that continue to shape modern employment standards.

Who We Are

## Why eDiscovery AI?

eDiscovery AI is at the forefront of legal technology, providing AI-powered solutions to streamline
and optimize discovery and privacy. Our mission is to empower legal teams with advanced AI
technology
that maximizes efficiency, enhances accuracy and improves cost effectiveness.

**EVERYWHERE ALL THE TIME**

Solutions that work across all platforms, providers and firms.

Security First

Strong encryption, no model
learning, no data storage.

**INDUSTRIAL STRENGTH**

Built to tackle the largest
data sets with speed.

Feature Rich

Ready for large files, images,
audio, foreign languages.

**HYPER SUPPORT**

Hands-on support from a deep bench with years of industry experience.

**PARTNER BESTIE** 

Our mantra is that your
success is our success.

AI-Powered Suites of Solutions

## Optimized data insights. Empowered by you.

Our solution areas – Early Case Intelligence, Review, Privacy, and Multimedia – provide
industry-leading features, speed, and accuracy. We are dedicated to delivering advanced AI solutions
with expert guidance to help our partners navigate the evolving data landscape.
* [
  Early Case Intelligence
  ][85]
* [
  Review
  ][86]
* [
  Privacy
  ][87]
* [
  Multimedia
  ][88]

### [Early Case Intelligence^{™}][89]

Introducing Case Insight for Early Case Intelligence, our AI-powered solution that delivers advanced
intelligence for the early case assessment process.

[Read More][90]

### [Review][91]

Our AI technology swiftly identifies and categorizes relevant documents, significantly reducing the
time and effort required for manual review. This ensures that your team can focus on high-value
tasks while maintaining precision and consistency.

[Read More][92]

### [Privacy][93]

Automatically detect privileged information to safeguard client confidentiality. Our advanced
algorithms recognize and flag potentially privileged content, minimizing the risk of inadvertent
disclosures.

[Read More][94]

### [Multimedia][95]

eDiscovery AI’s Multimedia suite streamlines document review by allowing users to handle image files
like standard documents. Users can quickly review thousands of images using the same prompts as for
text, making the process simpler and more cost-effective.

[Read More][96]

Proven Security, Trusted Protection

### Comprehensive defense for ultimate peace of mind.

#### At eDiscovery AI, we prioritize the security of our clients’ data. In collaboration with
#### Microsoft Azure, we enforce rigorous API security testing, conduct third-party audits,
#### implement advanced encryption, and adhere to data handling best practices. 

Your Data Stays Yours

We firmly uphold an unwavering commitment to privacy, trust, and ethical AI development, setting a
new standard for responsible innovation.

Encrypted and Protected
at Every Level

We encrypt all client data at every level and undergo regular third-party audits to ensure the
highest standards of protection.

Data Purged Within 24 Hours

Client data is never used to train any models and is immediately purged from our systems within 24
hours, adhering to strict data privacy principles, and ensuring no unnecessary data retention.

Partnership Program

## Commitment to our partners.

We are dedicated to delivering advanced AI technology with expert guidance to help our partners
navigate the evolving landscape of legal technology. We measure our success by our partner’s
success.

[
Learn More
][97]

“Understanding data early is what drives cost savings. When we use Case Insight to reduce a data set
at the front end, everything that follows becomes more efficient. Review populations shrink, hosting
and processing costs decrease, and teams can focus on what matters most. Beyond the operational
benefits, early insight helps legal teams develop strategy sooner, identify risks faster, and make
more informed decisions throughout the matter. The real value comes from understanding before review
even begins.”

[Esther Birnbaum EVP of Legal Data Intelligence, HaystackID]

##### Esther Birnbaum

EVP of Legal Data Intelligence

**HaystackID**

“eDiscovery AI is the latest cutting-edge solution added to the arsenal of tools and workflows we
employ to address the complexity and cost of legal review and another step in delivering a
comprehensive AI solution to our clients. We’re excited to leverage this technology to further
streamline critical aspects of document review, including relevance determination, privilege
identification, PII detection, and more.”

[Joe Pirrotta of Prosearch]

##### Joe Pirrotta

Director of Review Services

**ProSearch**

“eDiscovery AI is an exceptional partner—always responsive, incredibly helpful, and delivering a
truly impressive Generative AI solution for eDiscovery. A simple interface with demonstrably
excellent results, making reviews faster and more effective. We look forward to their continued
innovation and what we can accomplish for our clients.”

##### Jeff Johnson

Chief Innovation Officer 

**Purpose Legal**

### About EDRM

Empowering the global leaders of e-discovery, the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM)
creates practical global resources to improve e-discovery, privacy, security, and information
governance. Since 2005, EDRM has delivered leadership, standards, tools, guides, and test datasets
to strengthen best practices throughout the world. EDRM has an international presence in 145
countries, spanning 6 continents. EDRM provides an innovative support infrastructure for
individuals, law firms, corporations, and government organizations seeking to improve the practice
and provision of data and legal discovery with 19 active projects.

*With deep sadness, we share the loss of Kaylee Walstad, Chief Strategy Officer of EDRM and an
extraordinary advocate, mentor, and friend to so many in the eDiscovery and legal technology
community. Kaylee’s generosity, encouragement, and compassion touched countless lives, and her
legacy lives on in the people and organizations she lifted.*

It requires clarity on the type of growth being pursued, its strategic importance, and how it will
be executed successfully.

firms do not yet appear ready to meet.

stakeholder confidence, protect brand value and reinforce a culture of integrity.

### [Governing AI in healthcare: from liability risk to strategic advantage][59]

August 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

In an industry where AI is reshaping drug discovery, clinical operations, pharmacovigilance and
patient engagement simultaneously, the ability to govern AI well is no longer a compliance
requirement. It is a strategic differentiator.

[
][60]

### [CFIUS in 2026][61]

August 2026  |  BRIEFING ROOM

Given the broad scope of transactions that might be of interest to CFIUS, it is essential to
identify a transaction’s nexus to US national security, and to try to understand how the transaction
might help or hinder the US government’s national security priorities. FW discusses CFIUS in 2026
with Steve Klemencic at BRG, Ben Joseloff at Davis Polk, and Katie Clarke at Skadden, Arps, Slate,
Meagher & Flom LLP.

### [M&A in the oil & gas sector][62]

August 2026  |  BRIEFING ROOM

Strait of Hormuz disruption risk and fractures within OPEC+ have reinforced expectations of higher
for longer prices, which is precisely what is incentivising North American consolidation and
infrastructure investment. FW discusses M&A in the oil & gas sector with Dan Feldman at King &
Spalding and Frank Aquila at Sullivan & Cromwell LLP.

### [Maximising value in divestitures][63]

July 2026  |  TALKINGPOINT

Many organisations lose value because they go to market before they fully understand and can explain
how the business will actually operate as a standalone entity. FW discusses maximising value in
divestitures with J. Henning Buchholz, Brenda Ciampolillo, Lucy Julian, Ryan J. Stecz and Vinayak
Viswanathan at Deloitte.

### [The expanding role of economic evidence in climate and environmental disputes][64]

July 2026  |  MARKET PULSE

Claimants and defendants alike are being asked not simply whether climate harm exists, but how
costs, risks and burdens should be quantified, allocated and compared. With Sahar Shamsi, Nicole
Rosenboom and Kimela Shah at Oxera Consulting LLP.

### [The new corporate treasury playbook: managing FX risk amid trade fragmentation][76]

August 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

Successful treasury organisations are responding by moving beyond reactive hedging and building more
sophisticated, data-driven capabilities that improve visibility across the business, strengthen
forecasting and enable more agile decision making.

### [Minimising antitrust whistleblower risk in the M&A context][77]

July 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

Companies always face the risk of whistleblowers going directly to the government to report what
they perceive as violations of law. Those risks, however, are heightened for companies engaged in an
M&A transaction, particularly in the context of pre-close diligence and post-close integration.

### [Yellow card: the IRS flags US subsidiaries for transfer pricing][78]

July 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

The IRS has identified two intercompany transactions as focus areas of IRS scrutiny – transfer
prices paid by US distribution entities for the importation of goods and the interest rate paid on
intercompany loans from foreign parents.

### [Governing AI in healthcare: from liability risk to strategic advantage][59]

August 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

patient engagement simultaneously, the ability to govern AI well is no longer a compliance
requirement. It is a strategic differentiator.

### [CFIUS in 2026][61]

August 2026  |  BRIEFING ROOM

Given the broad scope of transactions that might be of interest to CFIUS, it is essential to
identify a transaction’s nexus to US national security, and to try to understand how the transaction
might help or hinder the US government’s national security priorities. FW discusses CFIUS in 2026
with Steve Klemencic at BRG, Ben Joseloff at Davis Polk, and Katie Clarke at Skadden, Arps, Slate,
Meagher & Flom LLP.

### [M&A in the oil & gas sector][62]

August 2026  |  BRIEFING ROOM

Strait of Hormuz disruption risk and fractures within OPEC+ have reinforced expectations of higher
for longer prices, which is precisely what is incentivising North American consolidation and
infrastructure investment. FW discusses M&A in the oil & gas sector with Dan Feldman at King &
Spalding and Frank Aquila at Sullivan & Cromwell LLP.

### [Maximising value in divestitures][63]

July 2026  |  TALKINGPOINT

Many organisations lose value because they go to market before they fully understand and can explain
how the business will actually operate as a standalone entity. FW discusses maximising value in
divestitures with J. Henning Buchholz, Brenda Ciampolillo, Lucy Julian, Ryan J. Stecz and Vinayak
Viswanathan at Deloitte.

### [The expanding role of economic evidence in climate and environmental disputes][64]

July 2026  |  MARKET PULSE

Claimants and defendants alike are being asked not simply whether climate harm exists, but how
costs, risks and burdens should be quantified, allocated and compared. With Sahar Shamsi, Nicole
Rosenboom and Kimela Shah at Oxera Consulting LLP.

August 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

sophisticated, data-driven capabilities that improve visibility across the business, strengthen
forecasting and enable more agile decision making.

### [Minimising antitrust whistleblower risk in the M&A context][77]

July 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

Companies always face the risk of whistleblowers going directly to the government to report what
they perceive as violations of law. Those risks, however, are heightened for companies engaged in an
M&A transaction, particularly in the context of pre-close diligence and post-close integration.

### [Yellow card: the IRS flags US subsidiaries for transfer pricing][78]

July 2026  |  SPOTLIGHT

The IRS has identified two intercompany transactions as focus areas of IRS scrutiny – transfer
prices paid by US distribution entities for the importation of goods and the interest rate paid on
intercompany loans from foreign parents.

# SIGNATURE SERVICES

In addition to its standard service offering, FFI provides these unique expert consulting services

FFI's [Breach Scan][23] forensically examines a computer or network resource and lets management
know if they are a victim of an outside penetration, data compromise, or unauthorized use.

[Breach Scan][24] can be used in litigation to assert or defend claims for remedial action and/or
damages. It can also be used to audit and confirm compliance with a settlement agreement or as a
means to assuage concerns about data compromise or abuse as part of an alternative resolution
method. < [Learn More][25] >

Download the [brochure][26]

 

# POPULAR ARTICLES

Founder Greg Fordham has authored over 70 manuscripts that have appeared in various publications and
professional education seminars. Some of the more popular articles are:

[Finding and Selecting a Computer Forensic Expert][27]

[Selecting an E-Discovery Vendor: A Best Value Approach][28]

[Eleven Steps to Designing an E-Discovery Plan and Protocol: A Systems Engineering Approach to
Modern Litigation][29]

[Do Computer Forensic Experts Need a PI License in Georgia?][30]

[Computerized Search and Other Digital Litigation Strategies][31]

[Using Keyword Search Terms in E-Discovery and How They Relate to Issues of Responsiveness,
Privilege, Evidence Standards and Rube Goldberg][32]

Many of his manuscripts are available in the articles section of our website under either;
* [Computer Publications][33], or
* [Accounting Publications][34].

# NEWS & EVENTS

Founder Greg Fordham will be making a national webinar presentation on Obtaining Evidence from
Electronic Devices for the National Business Institute on December 22, 2025.

*****


# ABOUT US

Located near Atlanta Georgia Fordham Forensics has over 25 years experience and an immense knowledge
of computer & cell phone forensics, electronic discovery (e-discovery), and computer security.

The firm provides nationwide expert consulting in the areas of incident response, forensic imaging
and digital evidence preservation and data collection for personal computing desktops, laptops,
tablets, flash drives, external hard drives, and cellphones including smart phones, as well as
enterprise grade workstations and servers, and cloud based data storage, web mail, Software as a
Service (SaaS), and video surveillance systems.

Firm projects typically involve recovery of deleted data, expert computer forensic analysis, and
keyword searching of digital computing devices in cases of misappropriated trade secrets, data
breaches and network intrusions, improper workplace behavior like harassment and discrimination,
improper device usage, fatal auto and truck accidents, spoliation analysis, fraud, criminal defense,
family law, and many others. Let us help you, When It Really Matters.

####  

# CONTACT US

#### Need an ESI Consultant or Computer Forensics Expert?

Computer forensics company specializing in computer forensics analysis, testimony and eDiscovery
consulting.

### Computer Forensics Company

Forensicon is the [Chicago-based computer forensics division][50] of QDiscovery, servicing clients
throughout the United States. We have testified as computer forensics experts in Federal, State and
County Courts. Our work and reporting has been upheld by the courts as admissible and valid. We
provide ESI discovery consulting services and also assist clients understanding their sources of ESI
in preparation for litigation and discovery production requests. When selecting computer forensics
services, turn to an experienced and established company with a proven track record of providing
quality and legally valid results.

### CORE TYPES OF PROJECTS
* [Investigations of Digital Trade Secret Theft / Company Data Misappropriation][51]
* [I][52][nternal Investigations Involving Employee Wrongful Activity][53]
* [Internet Investigations][54]
* [General Commercial and Employment Litigation][55]
* [Electronically Stored Information (ESI) Preservation & On-Site Collections and Discovery
  Production][56]
* [Computer Forensics Expert Witness Testimony][57]
* [Computer Forensics Reports and Affidavits][58]

### CORE TYPES OF CLIENTS SERVED
* Law Firms and Litigation Service Companies
* Software & Consulting Firms
* Financial Services Companies and Institutions
* Industrial Equipment Corporations
* Governmental & Non-Profit Organizations
* Healthcare Agencies, Hospitals & Insurance Providers

### FORENSICON NOTED CASES

###### **[Loest & McNamme v. Camera / Broadbent Selections][59]**

Plaintiff’s counsel filed a Motion for Sanctions against Defendants Katherine Camera, an individual,
and Broadbent Selections, Inc. Defendants’ Counsel Mr. Joseph Marconi and Mr. Victor J. Pioli of
Johnson & Bell LTD. successfully defeated those allegations using analysis of Forensicon’s Senior
Examiner, Yaniv Schiff. [Read More…][60]

###### **[Employment & Sanction Defense][61]**

Forensicon was retained to assist a local financial services company defend against multiple alleged
employment related claims including discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. The company’s
internal IT department had preserved some data related to discovery requests, but counsel wanted an
independent, experienced firm to perform an audit and verify the preservation techniques utilized.
[Read More…][62]

###### **[USG Receives $105 Million Settlement][63]**

CHICAGO: December 4, 2009 Plaintiffs US Gypsum Co. entered into a law suit against LaFarge North Am.
USG accused LaFarge of spoliation and patent infringement. USG also claimed that LaFarge stole
manufacturing information. Forensicon was the mutually agreed and court accepted neutral expert that
was charged with handling the collection of evidence and conducting the searches for responsive
electronic information. [Read More…][64]

throughout the United States. We have testified as computer forensics experts in Federal, State and

provide ESI discovery consulting services and also assist clients understanding their sources of ESI
in preparation for litigation and discovery production requests. When selecting computer forensics
services, turn to an experienced and established company with a proven track record of providing
quality and legally valid results.

### FORENSICON NOTED CASES

###### **[Loest & McNamme v. Camera / Broadbent Selections][59]**

Plaintiff’s counsel filed a Motion for Sanctions against Defendants Katherine Camera, an individual,
and Broadbent Selections, Inc. Defendants’ Counsel Mr. Joseph Marconi and Mr. Victor J. Pioli of
Johnson & Bell LTD. successfully defeated those allegations using analysis of Forensicon’s Senior
Examiner, Yaniv Schiff. [Read More…][60]

###### **[Employment & Sanction Defense][61]**

Forensicon was retained to assist a local financial services company defend against multiple alleged
employment related claims including discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. The company’s
internal IT department had preserved some data related to discovery requests, but counsel wanted an
independent, experienced firm to perform an audit and verify the preservation techniques utilized.
[Read More…][62]

###### **[USG Receives $105 Million Settlement][63]**

CHICAGO: December 4, 2009 Plaintiffs US Gypsum Co. entered into a law suit against LaFarge North Am.
USG accused LaFarge of spoliation and patent infringement. USG also claimed that LaFarge stole
manufacturing information. Forensicon was the mutually agreed and court accepted neutral expert that
was charged with handling the collection of evidence and conducting the searches for responsive
electronic information. [Read More…][64]

###### **[Trade Secrets & Non-Solicitation][65]**

Forensicon recently assisted a local manufacturing company that was investigating if a recently
departed employee misappropriated trade secrets or other proprietary information. Forensicon’s
investigation discovered the employee had taken clear steps to delete and hide his/her tracks using
multiple anti-forensics tools. [Read More…][66]

최근 미국에서는 생성형 AI와 대화한 내용을 소송에서 증거로 제출해야 하는지 여부가 쟁점이 된 판례들이

절차인 eDiscovery(이디스커버리) 과정에서, Attorney-Client Privilege(변호사-의뢰인 비밀유지권)와
Work-Product Doctrine(변호사 업무 결과물 원칙)은 증거 제출 의무를 방어하는 매우 중요한 장치입니다.
오늘 다룰 두 사건은 모두 생성형 AI를 소송 준비 과정에 활용한 경우지만, 법원은 eDiscovery 제출 대상

AI와의 대화, 미국 법원에서 eDiscovery 증거가 될까? Hepp ...

최근 미국에서는 생성형 AI와 대화한 내용을 소송에서 증거로 제출해야 하는지 여부가 쟁점이 된 판례들이
등장했습니다. 주요 법률 매체와 로펌을 중심으로 관련 분석도 활발히 이루어지고 있습니다. 미국 소송
절차인 eDiscovery(이디스커버리) 과정에서, Attorney-Client Privilege(변호사-의뢰인 비밀유지권)와
Work-Product Doctrine(변호사 업무 결과물 원칙)은 증거 제출 의무를 방어하는 매우 중요한 장치입니다.
오늘 다룰 두 사건은 모두 생성형 AI를 소송 준비 과정에 활용한 경우지만, 법원은 eDiscovery 제출 대상
여부를 각각 다르게 판단했습니다. 인텔렉추얼데이터는 화제의 두 사건 판례를 비교 분석해, 기업이 미국
소송 eDiscovery에서 자료 제출 및 방어를 위해 사전에 점검해야 할 부분을 실무적 관점에서
정리했습니다. ✔ 미국 법조계의 뜨거운 이슈: Heppner, Warner 사건이 화제가 된 이유는? 1. 생성형 AI
사용 확대 흐름에서 등장한 사례2. AI와의 대화의 증거성, 법적 취급에 관한 미국 법원 최초·초기 판결3.
공개 AI 플랫폼에 관한 법원의 판단 기준 제시 두 사건은 생성형 AI를 사용한 소송 준비라는 공통점이
있으나, 같은 날 상반된 판단이 내려졌습니다. 법원은 Heppner 사건을 “first impression”, 즉 해당 쟁점을
최초로 다룬 판결이라고 명시했습니다. Heppner 건은 AI와의 커뮤니케이션이 미국 소송 eDiscovery
과정에서, Attorney-Client Privilege 또는 Work Product 보호, 즉 eDiscovery 제출 의무 방어에
해당하는지 처음 판단한 사건이 되었습니다. 이 사건은 AI 사용 주체 및 목적, 변호사의 개입 여부, 데이터
수집·학습·공개 범위 등에 따라 법원의 판단이 달라질 수 있음을 보여주었습니다. 또한 Warner 사건은
변호사 없이 소송을 진행한 당사자(pro se)가 생성형 AI로 준비한 자료도 Work Product 보호를 받을 수
있음을 보여준 사례로 주목받았습니다. *Attorney-Client Privilege(ACP): 변호사-의뢰인 비밀유지 특권.
의뢰인이 법률 조언을 구하기 위해 변호사와 주고받은 의사소통의 비밀을 보장*Work Product Doctrine:
변호사 업무 결과물 원칙. 소송 준비 과정에서 변호사가 작성하거나, 변호사의 지시·개입에 의해 작성된
자료를 보호하는 원칙  ✔ Heppner - 생성형 AI로 소송을 준비한 자료, eDiscovery 공개 or Privilege(특권)
보호 대상인가?판례: United States v. Heppner, No. 25-cr-00503 (S.D.N.Y. Feb. 17, 2026) 사건
배경 여러 기업 임원으로 재직했던 Heppner는 증권·전신 사기 등의 혐의로 2025년 10월 형사
기소되었습니다. Heppner는 소환장을 받고 변호인을 선임한 상태에서, Anthropic의 소비자용 AI인
클로드(Claude)를 이용해 방어 전략과 법적 주장을 정리한 31개의 프롬프트 및 문서를 작성했고, 이후 이
자료를 변호인과 공유했습니다. FBI 자택 압수수색

백도어 삽입? 지속되는 보안 관련 논란그러나 좀 이상합니다. 클린 코드 원칙 이야기를 하지만 잘 지켜지지
않을뿐더러, 소스가 공개돼 있는데 백도어를 다 보이게 심어놨다는 게 쉽게 납득하기 힘듭니다. 중국
레지스트리 사이트 역시 다른 단계가 아니라 로그인 단계에서 중국 통신사 네트워크 주소가 하드코딩되어
있다는 것을 증거라고 주장하고 있는거죠. 그런데 실제 개발을 해 보면 서버 주소나 암호화 키 등은
암호화가 되어 숨겨집니다. 저렇게 드러내는 것이 오히려 더 어색하죠.일각에서는 이를 보고 '중국의 세계
감시', '기술 탈취'를 이야기하지만 아직까지 드러난 바에 따르면 과도한 공포가 아닐까 하는 의구심을
갖게 한다는 것입니다. 정말로 숨길 의도가 있었다면 더 깔끔한 방법으로, 티나지 않게 숨길 수가
있거든요. 많은 사람들은 이런 갑작스러운 차단에 대해 미국이 OAI를 차세대 성장 동력으로 내세우는
가운데 스타게이트 프로젝트를 발족하면서 딥 시크의 등장이 달갑지 않아서 스타게이트 프로젝트
참가국들을 통해 압박을 하고 있다는 해석을 내놓기도 했습니다. 실제 미국 FCC(연방통신위원회, Federal
Radio Commission)은 차이나모바일을 국가안보 위협으로 지정하기도 했는데, 이 상황에서 딥 시크 로그인
페이지에서 해당 기업의 코드가 발견되었다는 점에서 더욱 더 문제시하려는 것 아닌가 하는 의혹도
있습니다.딥 시크 보안에 대한 우려와 중국 정부의 반발각국 정부와 기업이 보안 우려에 따라 중국 AI 모델
딥 시크 사용 금지에 나서자, 중국은 불법 데이터 수집은 없다며 반발에 나섰는데요. 궈자쿤 중국 외교부
대변인은 정례 브리핑에서 "중국은 국가 안보 개념을 일반화하고 경제·무역 문제를 정치화하는 방식에
일관되게 반대해왔다"며 "지금껏 기업 혹은 개인에 위법한 형식으로 데이터를 수집·저장하라고 요구한 적도
없고 요구하지도 않을 것"이라고 강조했습니다. 아울러 중국 기업의 합법적 권익을 굳게 수호할 것이라며
경우에 따라 보복 조치에 나설 수 있다고 말했습니다. 하지만 중국의 국가정보법 상 모든 조직과 개인이
정부의 정보 활동을 지원하고 협력하도록 요구하고 있기 때문에, 중국 당국은 딥 시크가 수집한 해외
사용자의 데이터에 접근할 가능성이 있다는 우려 자체는 상존하고 있습니다. 실제 중국은 다양한 분야에서
과도한 개인정보를 가져가는 모습을 보여줬거든요. 물론 아직까지 딥 시크가 이런 위험성이 있다는 것이
증명되진 않았지만, 이번 딥 시크 사태를 놓고 미국과 중국이 다투는 것은 AI 기술이 가져올 수 있는
개인정보 보호, 데이터 주권, 국가 안보, 기술 헤게모니 등 다양한 문제를 잘 보여준다고 생각합니다.국가
간 데이터 흐름을 관리할 통일된 프레임워크의 필요성사실 국제사회는 이런 문제에 대응하기 위해 다양한
규제 프레임워크를 제시하고 있습니다. 대표적인 것이 EU의 COMPL-AI 프레임워크입니다. 이 프레임워크는
AI 모델의 해킹 위험과 편향성을 체계적으로 평가하는 기술적 규제의 선례를 제시하고 있습니다. EU AI
Act의 6대 윤리 원칙을 27개의 기술 벤치마크로 구체화하여, 프롬프트 유출이나 목표 변조와 같은 사이버
보안 위협에 대한 모델의 취약성을 진단하고, HarmBench 데이터셋을 활용해 인종과 성별 편향성을 정량화
합니다. 오는 2025년 4월부터 EU AI Act의 공식 감사 도구로 활용됩니다. 하지만 아직까지 범 국가 간 단일
모델, 통일 프레임워크는 만들어지지 않았습니다.그리고 국가 간 데이터 흐름, 소위 크로스보더 데이터
흐름에 대한 관리의 중요성 역시 부각되게 되었습니다. EU의 GDPR, Data Act, 미국 법무부(DOJ) 등의
정책이 충돌하게 된거죠. 프레임워크를 비롯해 데이터 관리에 있어서 까지 국제 공조, 조화가 시급한
과제가 되고 있는 상황입니다. 미-중간의 다툼도, AI의 미래를 위한 경쟁도 좋지만 무엇보다 사람들이
안전한 시스템을 쓸 수 있도록 투명한 체계를 만드는 것이 피할 수 없는 AI의 대두 시대, 그리고 그
시대에서 살아갈 인류의 공공복리를 위해 필요한 내용이 아닐까 생각됩니다.

미국과 중국의 갈등 격화! 사이버 냉전 시대의 시작?

올해 가장 많이 뉴스에 오르내릴 무역 이슈로는 단연 미국과 중국의 충돌이 꼽힙니다. 실제로 지난 1기
정부 시기 미-중 무역분쟁을 시작했던 도널드 트럼프 당선인이 지난 20일 미국 대통령에 공식 취임하면서
새롭게 미-중간 갈등이 다시 재점화될 가능성이 매우 높아 보이는데요. 이미 트럼프 당선인은 중국에 대한
공세와 압박에 적극 나설 것임을 본인의 SNS 등을 통해 수 차례 언급한 적 있었습니다. 중국에 강력한 보복
관세를 물리는 것은 물론 반도체 부문 등 각종 규제를 통해 중국을 옥죄겠다는 의지를 노골적으로 천명해
왔죠.트럼프 대통령 2기의 시작, 새로운 사이버 냉전의 시작 통상뿐만 아닙니다. 양국간의 사이버 전쟁
역시 치열하게 벌어지고 있습니다. 바로 한국시간 17일, 블룸버그는 지난해 말 있었던 미국 재무부 해킹
당시, 중국 해커가 재닛 옐런 재무장관의 컴퓨터까지 침입, 비밀로 지정되지 않은 40여 개의 파일에
접근했다고 보도했습니다. 해커들은 또한 윌리 아데예모 재무부 부장관과 브래드 스미스 차관 대행의
컴퓨터에도 침투한 것으로 전해졌는데요. 미 재무부는 중국 해커

# Litigation Support Services You Can Trust

Dealing with the volume of information involved in a lawsuit can be overwhelming. With countless
paper documents and extensive digital records in various formats, the task of reviewing it all can
take weeks or even months for a team to cull through.

That’s where KEY Discovery comes in. For many years we have been providing comprehensive litigation
support services for MA local and out-of-town law firms. Whether you need assistance from the
initial assessment to post-trial briefs, we expertly manage the document discovery process, both in
electronic ([eDiscovery][30]) and paper formats ([Paper Discovery][31]).

KEY Discovery’s expertise extends beyond document discovery. We also offer services in court
reporting, depositions, trial exhibits, courtroom technology, and other corporate solutions,
offering you a complete range of litigation support services.  We are a Boston based litigation
support firm that helps you navigate the challenges posed by the immense volume of information
involved in lawsuits, while maximizing efficiency and cost-effectiveness. It all starts with a
simple call at [617.348.9360][32].

[Request a free consultation][33] today to learn the KEY to success.

 

## Our Litigation Support & eDiscovery Services:

[**eDiscovery Services**][34] – Our electronic discovery (“eDiscovery”) helps you collect, hold, and
find the most important data when you need it.  With our eDiscovery team we can help law firms,
corporations and solo litigation attorneys efficiently manage volumes of data to  better prepare
their legal cases.

[**Paper Discovery Services**][35] – Whether you are a solo-practitioner attorney or a large law
firm, we can help you get organized with the high volume of documents your clients bring.  We can
scan, read and prioritize all of your documents so that you can quickly access them when need be.

[**Court Reporting Services**][36] – Our deposition services allow law firms to work with one of our
highly trained and professional court reporters.  Our court reporter network allows you to utilize
deposition services anywhere and any time.

[**Trial Support Services**][37] – Proper litigation support is key to a strong courtroom
presentation.  From jury handbooks to witness kits, to courtroom presentation materials and mounts
our litigation and trial support team can help you better prepare for your trial.

[

### Tech Stack – Civil Litigation Defense: Medical and Catastrophic Injury

][2]
[
[Legaltech Hub]
Legaltech Hub][3]
[

Published 2026-07-24

Although any law firm can use a foundational set of technologies to broadly support its lawyers,
different practice areas have specific needs that often require unique capabilities. The Tech Stack
series provides readers with a recommended set of tools to optimize the quality and effectiveness of
legal work and output in particular practices or environments based on industry expertise. This real
estate law Tech Stack is based on the expert contributions of Keely Duke, Attorney & Founding
Member, Duke Evett, PLLC.

][4]
[

### LTH Product Briefing – CobbleStone Contract Insight 2026 Update

][5]
[
[Legaltech Hub]
Legaltech Hub][6]
[

Published 2026-07-21

][7]

[CobbleStone Contract Insight][8] is CobbleStone's flagship Enterprise contract lifecycle management
(CLM) platform, built to centralize and automate the process of requesting, negotiating, and
tracking legal agreements. In a recent interview, [Bradford Jones][9], CobbleStone's Vice President
of Sales and Marketing, and [Michael Gormley][10], CobbleStone Sales Manager, discussed the problem
Contract Insight solves, its key use cases, and what differentiates it in the market.

[

### 5 Prompting Habits Costing You Tokens and Accuracy

][11]
[
[Nabiha Khwaja]
Nabiha Khwaja][12]
[

Published 2026-07-16

Effective prompting is less about saying more than it is about saying the right things. Yet much of
the existing guidance encourages longer, increasingly detailed instructions in pursuit of better
answers. The result is often higher costs and weaker outputs. This article explains why disciplined
prompting consistently outperforms verbose prompting, particularly in legal workflows where
precision is of utmost importance.

][13]
[

### Litera Relaunches with Unified Platform for Business and Practice of Law

][14]
[
[Stephanie Wilkins]
Stephanie Wilkins][15]
[

Published 2026-07-15

Emphasizing 30 years’ experience serving the Am Law 100, Litera has announced a company relaunch
focused on bringing the business and practice of law together in a single platform. In the new
unified platform, the company’s AI agent Lito will now expand beyond Litera One to sit across the
entire Litera ecosystem and touch all legal workflows via a single login.

][16]
[

### LTH Product Briefing – AtlasAI

][17]
[
[Legaltech Hub]
Legaltech Hub][18]
[

Published 2026-07-02

][19]

[AtlasAI][20] is a private AI infrastructure platform built for law firms and legal departments that
need to retain full ownership and control of their data. In a recent interview, founder [Stephen
Costigan][21] discussed the problems AtlasAI solves, its key use cases, and what differentiates it
in the market.

[

### LTH GenAI Legal Tech Map: June 2026

][22]
[
[Legaltech Hub]
Legaltech Hub][23]
[

Published 2026-07-01

AI from 949 providers across 19 different categories. We have created an interactive map of these
solutions and the categories they operate in for your exploration.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

* ## The Parcels Advantage
* ### Experienced, dedicated staff
  
  Serving customers across the world since 1980.
* ### 24/7 availability
  
  Responsive and accurate.
  We work when you work.
* ### Full service, scalable solutions
  
  Expert team, industry leading technology, best in class software.
* ### Privately-owned and operated
  
  Personal service, professional results.
  Fully Insured and Bonded.
* ### Parcels is ISO 27001 Certified
  
  World-Class Information Security for Parcels Clients

## Our Partners

At Parcels, we work with cutting-edge technology partners to ensure only the best in productivity,
security, hosting, and trusted eDiscovery solutions.

"I would like to acknowledge the good work that Parcels continues to provide to us. Our relationship
is a historical one - we go way back - but it wouldn't be what it is today without the consistent
and sustained customer service that is the result of the work ethic of each individual member of
your team. There has never been a moment or a time that you have not provided the highest level of
customer service. Your responsiveness and dedication is evident in every stage of the workflow from
the intake through execution. Parcels. A model of excellence."

**Michele Curcio
Director of Litigation Support Services
Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz**

“I continue to be amazed at the Parcels guys each time I am in town. They are so efficient, friendly
and incredibly polite. I can only hope my own son will be as polite as the guys you employ. I don’t
know how you do it. I wish Parcels was in every city!”

**Jodi L. Loper
Legal Assistant
Bartlit Beck Herman Palenchar & Scott LLP**

"I can’t say enough how completely professional, friendly, and helpful each and every member of your
staff is. I look forward to working with you again. You guys have the best trial support company
around and you’ve gained some fans for life!

**Tara R. Kramek
Paralegal
Axinn, Veltrop & Harkrider LLP**

"Thank you again for everything Parcels has done for us. I’ve received many compliments about your
service from the out-of-state attorneys regarding the services you provide and this is one of the
reasons I always use Parcels."

**Lori M. Gibson
Secretary
Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP**

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

With Progressive, you can take your boat to any lake or river, plus ocean waters within 75 miles of
the coast. And we offer a variety of coverages to protect your boat and the good times that come
with it. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and
more, you can float on without worry.
